Quick update from schema validation:

- The sample PO XML uses <ns1:TaxJurisdiction> with a custom child element <TaxRegionCode>. Our PO normalization expects <TaxCounty> / <TaxState>. Mapping gap — I'll add a transformation rule to map TaxRegionCode -> TaxCounty for the immediate onboarding.
- UnitOfMeasure is present as "EA" which is fine.
- We recommend adding a PO-level custom field for buyerContactEmail (Ariba optional header) so our EDI backfill can populate Redwood billing contact if PO lacks it.

Action items:
- Markus: will push a mapping patch to the onboarding branch (expected by COB today) and attach a sample transformed XML.
- Laura: once signer matrix is confirmed, route Order Form redline to Sarah for legal concurrence. If approved, we will publish DocuSign envelope and set signing order (Sarah -> MedAlign procurement).
